intents.name: greeting
intents.answer: Hello! Welcome to the university help desk. How can I help you today?

intents.name: hours
intents.answer: The help desk is open Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. It is closed on Sunday and on public holidays.

intents.name: admission
intents.answer: For admission, visit the Admissions Office or check the university website for the current application process and deadlines.

intents.name: fees
intents.answer: Fee details depend on your program. Please check the Fee section on the university website, or ask at the Accounts Office.

intents.name: library
intents.answer: The library is open during working hours. Bring your student ID card to borrow books.

intents.name: contact
intents.answer: You can reach the help desk by phone or email. Check the Contact page on the university website for the latest numbers.
